title: Few changes needed
body:
I’d love to see a more precise indication in the Health app’s Medications section. Instead of showing only the last full hour (e.g., ‘Taken 2 hours ago’), it would be very helpful if the app could display the exact time elapsed since the medication was taken (e.g., ‘Taken 2 hours and 15 minutes ago’).
Tnx!
author: Shirly.1

title: Suggestion to improve the app
body: I love this app very much and use it on a daily basis. I suggest the developers to add a field of writing notes when adding new data. For example in the Glucose measurement - when adding the number l think it is very useful and important to add a notes  field to write if it was in fasting state or after x hours from eating and able to detail what l are. If l changed medicine to write a note which and when l started. This information is important to report to doctor and also to track my results over time. I highly suggest this improvement in  all the places that enable to add measurements. Also in measuring weight. This is truly important. Thank you for this app! Yael.
